ios.desc:
Meet Alana — your personal AI guide that turns your unique Soulprint into practical daily guidance and calendar-aware planning.

YOUR SOULPRINT
Alana starts by mapping your Soulprint — a personal profile built from three time-tested lenses:
• Human Design — your energy type, strategy, and decision-making style
• Personality typology — a short assessment of how you think, decide, and recharge
• Numerology — your Life Path number and personal-year themes

Every insight Alana gives is personalized to this profile. No generic advice.

DAILY GUIDANCE
• A fresh daily reading: today's energy, one aligned action, and a transit highlight
• A daily affirmation matched to your profile
• Habit-building quests with small daily steps — and an owl companion that grows with you

CONVERSATIONAL AI GUIDE
Chat with Alana anytime about career, relationships, productivity, or personal growth:
• Context-aware conversations grounded in your Soulprint
• Practical next steps, not platitudes

CALENDAR-AWARE PLANNING
Connect Google or Apple Calendar:
• See your real schedule alongside your cosmic calendar in one view
• Suggestions for focused work, rest windows, and preparing for important events
• Your event titles never leave your device — only categories and times are processed

PRIVACY-FOCUSED
• Personal and birth data encrypted in storage
• Clear AI and data-use disclosures in-app
• No advertising of any kind — the app is completely ad-free

PLANS
Free:
• Full Soulprint profile
• Daily transit highlight and a daily affirmation
• 3 full Ask Alana conversations per day

Premium Access (auto-renewing subscription — monthly, annual, and weekly options):
• Ask Alana up to 50 times a day
• Energy Insight and Aligned Action, unlocked every day
• Full cosmic calendar — day-by-day detail and personalized insights
• Deeper, more personalized AI responses

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://alanaai.web.id/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://alanaai.web.id/privacy-policy
